business_problem: turn vast but fragmented community, social, review, and video data into timely sentiment insight for game publishers without months of manual analysis.
solution_summary: Keywords Studios uses Snowflake and Cortex AI on Snowflake to turn vast but fragmented community, social, review, and video data into timely sentiment insight for game publishers without months of manual analysis. Viewership, streaming, metadata, and audience data are centralized in Snowflake so marketing, merchandising, and customer-experience teams can work from a faster, more reliable operating view. Cortex AI adds in-platform LLM and agentic capabilities for classification, summarization, retrieval, or natural-language analytics on top of the curated data foundation. The platform also connects with AWS so upstream systems and downstream consumers stay aligned around the same governed data assets. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, simplifies operations, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across analytics, reporting, and AI. Keywords Studios achieved 3 months from AI POC to go-live.
